misprints.note: First occurrence (Middag 2) is printed with an acute; the later one in Middagsgäst has a circumflex
The article is printed as masculine τὸν with the neuter noun
The headword is printed with three d's
Acute printed on the first epsilon as well as on upsilon
'i m:u af sommaren': an n printed as u, probably a turned type
'ἔχειν τὸ προς-ωπον' at a line break: no accent, and ς before the hyphen kept as printed

uncertain.note: The closing parenthesis is broken (only its top shows); read as ')'
The omicron of μέσος is heavily inked and could look like θ; read as μέσος. The colon after 3 is as printed
The accent is faint and slightly breve-like; read as a circumflex
Read the mark over η as an acute alone, with no breathing
The mark under α read as an iota subscript
